summary.en: Chinese Coast Guard vessels have used water cannons to block Philippine Coast Guard ships conducting medical evacuations at Ayungin Shoal, near Ren’ai Jiao, and in the Luzon Strait, and fired on a PCG ship during a medevac of a navy serviceman. Philippine Coast Guard, Marine Corps and Navy forces have jointly repelled Chinese militia vessels and 22 sampans that intruded into the territorial sea of Kota Island. China has warned the Philippines to stop its alleged infringements after a PCG vessel transported an injured person from a grounded ship near Ren’ai. 176 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Kinesiske kystvaktskip har brukt vannkanoner for å blokkere filippinske kystvaktskip som gjennomførte medisinske evakueringer ved Ayungin-revet, nær Ren’ai Jiao, og i Luzonstredet, og har skutt på et PCG-skip under en medevac av en marineansatt. Filippinske kystvakt, marinekorps og marinen har i fellesskap avverget kinesiske militsfartøy og 22 sampaner som trengte inn i territorialvannet rundt Kota-øya. Kina har advart Filippinene om å stoppe sine påståtte overtredelser etter at et PCG-fartøy fraktet en skadet person fra et grunnstøtt skip nær Ren’ai. 176 kamprelaterte dødsfall inntraff i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Moro conflict
background.extract: The Moro conflict was an insurgency in the Mindanao region in southern Philippines which involved multiple armed groups. A decades-long peace process has resulted in peace deals between the Philippine government and two major armed groups, the Moro National Liberation Front (MNLF) and the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF), but other smaller armed groups continue to exist. In 2017, the peace council settled around 138 clan conflicts.
